Container.Name: TautWeekly for Plex
Container.Overview: Generate preview-first weekly Plex activity newsletters using Tautulli, then send controlled tests before enabling scheduled delivery. After installation, open the container Console and run: pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -File /opt/tautweekly/Setup-First.ps1
Container.Description: TautWeekly for Plex generates activity, welcome, quiet-week, and milestone email newsletters. Configuration and generated output stay in appdata. Scheduling is disabled by default. Review browser previews and TestEmail delivery before enabling production sends.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: Tautulli Plex newsletter email activity digest
Container.Requires: A reachable Tautulli server, an SMTP STARTTLS account, and a trusted LAN port for browser previews.
Container.Changes: 2026-08-04: Initial Community Apps template with a published amd64/arm64 image and persistent appdata.

Config.Name: Preview WebUI
Config.Description: Trusted-LAN HTTP port for generated newsletter previews. Do not expose it to the public internet.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Private configuration, state, logs, assets, and generated previews.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: IANA timezone used by the weekly scheduler, for example America/Phoenix.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Non-root Unraid user ID used for appdata ownership.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Non-root Unraid group ID used for appdata ownership.

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: Restrictive file-creation mask for configuration and output.

Config.Name: Preview Base URL
Config.Description: Optional LAN URL embedded in preview links, for example http://tower:8787. Never use a public URL.
